products.name: Glorious Gaming Padded Keyboard Rest
products.blurb: Key specs: Compact tenkeyless size, Memory foam with microfiber cover, Available in full-size and TKL.
strengths: Sized specifically for TKL keyboards, no overhang
Microfiber cover is softer and less moisture-absorbent than cloth
Stitched edges confirmed durable after 6 months
Available in multiple colors to match Glorious keyboard aesthetics
limitations: Microfiber shows wrist marks and smudges more visibly than cloth
Less widely available than Corsair in brick-and-mortar stores
